evidence.proposition: Retrying an interrupted Phase 1 render converges on the incoming implement-wave prompt, its generated review-policy region and the replaced finding required by 24bn8 AC-1.
evidence.failure_condition: The renderer returns success on retry with a missing policy region or a stale comparison finding.
evidence.command_or_fixture: From .wavefoundry/framework/scripts run PYTHONPATH=.:tests python3 -B ../../work/24buu/delivery/code-retry.py. Run python3 -B -m unittest with PYTHONPATH=.:tests for the four BaselineDriftTests listed in delivery/code-repair-controls.log.
evidence.expected: After a rejected intent checkpoint the original bytes remain intact. Retry of a partially published target finishes recording and regenerates the policy region only for the exact published bytes. An intervening local date edit remains byte-identical.
evidence.observed: The public retry returned 0 after the original injected exit 1 and retained the incoming prose, restored the policy marker and recorded replaced. All four focused tests passed with zero skips. The post-publication checkpoint failure recovered and cleared the pending digest. Editing only the date before retry preserved all local bytes and kept the original finding. The in-memory mutant that ignored the pending digest failed the byte-preservation assertion.
evidence.artifact_or_test_id: delivery/code-retry-confirmed.log, delivery/code-repair-controls.log, delivery/code-repair-mutant.log and the original delivery/code-retry.log under .wavefoundry/work/24buu; frozen file fingerprint 8d729920b9f45b89c354f519637d64e36d6e2d64afd487f0f8a3754ba4174b2e
evidence.known_bad_detection_method: The identical public replay previously returned success with a missing policy region and stale finding. It now passes both assertions. Removing the exact-byte comparison from the pending-replacement path in an isolated Python process failed test_retry_preserves_edit_after_incomplete_receipt at the byte-preservation assertion.
evidence.limitations: Checkpoint failures were injected at the writer boundary in isolated local targets. The reviewer ran the public render entry and focused tests. Coordinator-owned packaged two-hop verification is separate.
evidence.safety_and_authorization: Disposable local target and isolated host settings. No installed workspace or external service is mutated by the probes.
evidence.disposition_rationale: The exact-byte pending receipt allows the ordinary retry to complete the publication and preserves later edits. The repaired renderer satisfies the disputed 24bn8 AC-1 property.
